name: saga-runtime
description: Payment-specific Saga Runtime with AI risk analysis for agentic payment failure recovery

scripts.eval: node -e "const{MockRiskAnalyzer}=require('./src/ai/risk-analyzer');const{evaluate,printReport,printProvenance,printAllReports}=require('./src/ai/evaluate');const{getDevSet,getHeldOutSet,getFinalTestSet}=require('./src/ai/eval-dataset');(async()=>{printAllReports();const a=new MockRiskAnalyzer();console.log('--- Development Set (60 examples) ---');printReport(await evaluate(a,getDevSet()));console.log();console.log('--- Contaminated Holdout (40 examples) ---');console.log('WARNING: Not an unbiased estimate. See provenance.');printReport(await evaluate(a,getHeldOutSet()));console.log();console.log('--- Final Test Set (45 examples, FROZEN) ---');printReport(await evaluate(a,getFinalTestSet()));})();"
